theorem complete_partial_family (k : ℕ)
    (A : Fin k → Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 5) ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ r, (A r)ᴴ * A r = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ))
    (hf : ∀ r, ∀ i j : Fin 5, Complex.normSq (A r i.castSucc j) = 1)
    (ho : ∀ r s, r < s → ∀ i j : Fin 5, Complex.normSq (((A r)ᴴ * A s) i j) = 6) :
    ∃ H : Fin k → Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ,
      (∀ r, (H r)ᴴ * H r = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ r i j, Complex.normSq (H r i j) = 1) ∧
      (∀ r s, r < s → ∀ i j, Complex.normSq (((H r)ᴴ * H s) i j) = 6) ∧
      (∀ r i j, H r i j.castSucc = A r i j) := by
  have hcompletion (r : Fin k) := Matrix.exists_scaled_orthogonal_completion 5 6 (by norm_num) (A r) (hg r)
  choose H hH hcolumns using hcompletion
  refine ⟨H, hH, ?_, ?_, hcolumns⟩
  · intro r
    apply Matrix.normSq_eq_of_scaled_unitary_core 5 1 (by norm_num) (H r)
    · simpa using hH r
    · intro i j
      simpa only [hcolumns] using hf r i j
  · intro r s hrs
    apply Matrix.normSq_eq_of_scaled_unitary_core 5 6 (by norm_num) ((H r)ᴴ * H s)
    · convert cross_gram (H r) (H s) (hH r) (hH s) using 1
      norm_num
    · intro i j

theorem reconstruct_unbiased_basis {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] (d : ℕ) (hd : Module.finrank ℂ E = d)
    (T : Fin d → E →ₗ[ℂ] E) (hT : ∀ i, (T i).IsSymmetric)
    (hc : ∀ i j, T i * T j = T j * T i) (hli : LinearIndependent ℂ T) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin d) ℂ E, ∀ v : E,
      (∀ i, inner ℂ v (T i v) = LinearMap.trace ℂ E (T i) / (d : ℂ)) →
      ∀ j, Complex.normSq (inner ℂ v (b j)) = 1 / (d : ℝ) := by
  exact (by
    classical
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := spectral_projectors_span d hd T hT hc hli
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    intro v hv j
    let f : (E →ₗ[ℂ] E) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toFun := fun A => inner ℂ v (A v) - LinearMap.trace ℂ E A / (d : ℂ)
        map_add' := by intro A B; simp [inner_add_right, add_div]; ring
        map_smul' := by intro c A; simp [inner_smul_right, mul_div_assoc]; ring }

theorem six_MUBs_residual_commuting_suffices
    (B : Fin 6 → M)
    (hB : ∀ r, IsOrthonormalBasis6 (B r))
    (hBB : ∀ r s, r ≠ s → MutuallyUnbiased6 (B r) (B s))
    (K : Fin 6 → M) (hK : ∀ i, (K i)ᴴ = K i)
    (hr : ∀ i, K i ∈ LinearMap.range (residual B))
    (hc : ∀ i j, K i * K j = K j * K i)
    (hli : LinearIndependent ℂ K) :
    ∃ C : Fin 7 → M, IsCompleteMUB6 C := by
  let T := fun i => Matrix.toEuclideanLin (K i)
  have hT : ∀ i, (T i).IsSymmetric := fun i => Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr (hK i)
  have hC : ∀ i j, T i * T j = T j * T i := by
    intro i j
    ext x a
    change (K i *ᵥ (K j *ᵥ (fun a => x a))) a = (K j *ᵥ (K i *ᵥ (fun a => x a))) a

theorem six_MUBs_complete (B : Fin 6 → M)
    (hB : ∀ r, IsOrthonormalBasis6 (B r))
    (hBB : ∀ r s, r ≠ s → MutuallyUnbiased6 (B r) (B s)) :
    ∃ C : Fin 7 → M, IsCompleteMUB6 C := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hr,hli⟩ := residual_generators B hB hBB
  exact six_MUBs_residual_commuting_suffices B hB hBB K hK hr
    (fun i j => automatic_residual_commutes B hB hBB _ _ (hr i) (hr j)) hli

import Mathproof.BinaryDualSupportDesign

/-! # Incidence-pair and point-permutation design automorphisms coincide

Blocks are actual subsets, so their permutation is uniquely determined by the
point permutation. No finiteness or separation assumption on points is needed.
-/

namespace IncidenceDesignAutomorphisms

variable {I : Type*}

def incidenceAut (B : Set (Set I)) :
    Subgroup (Equiv.Perm I × Equiv.Perm B) where
  carrier := {e | ∀ p b, p ∈ b.val ↔ e.1 p ∈ (e.2 b).val}
  one_mem' := by intro p b; rfl
